::: {.ter-status}
Planned expansion
:::

Additional fabrication methods will be added only when useful instruction, appropriate safety context, and authentic classroom projects are available.

## Future methods

- vinyl cutting and applied graphics;
- plasma cutting and thermal-cutting workflows;
- sheet-metal layout, cutting, bending, and fastening;
- vacuum forming and mold design;
- molding and casting;
- composite layup and finishing;
- hybrid projects that choose several processes for different functions.

Each future pathway should begin with the N.I.C.E. design process, explain what the process is suited to, distinguish digital geometry from machine setup, and require testing rather than presenting generic settings as universal.

## Free cross-process resources

Study documented builds on [Instructables](https://www.instructables.com/) and [Hackaday.io](https://hackaday.io/projects), repair and disassembly through [iFixit](https://www.ifixit.com/), open recycling systems through [Precious Plastic](https://www.preciousplastic.com/about/open-source), and circular-design principles through the [Ellen MacArthur Foundation](https://www.ellenmacarthurfoundation.org/topics/circular-design/overview). The [full free-resource directory](../resources/index.qmd) groups many more tools and references by fabrication task and explains what must be checked before reuse.

::: {.ter-curriculum-relevance}
**Ontario curriculum relevance:** Future connections may include **TMJ**, **TDJ**, **TCJ**, **TTJ**, **TGJ**, and **TIJ1O**, depending on the process and project. No page should claim course relevance until its actual learning and evidence justify the connection.
:::
